descripcion: At C2 negotiation includes naming the other party's real interest before they do, which builds trust precisely because it shows you've understood their position better than a purely tactical move would require — and knowing when to concede something unprompted, before it's asked for, to change the frame of the whole exchange.

filas: I suspect what actually matters to you here is timing, not price.
Before you ask, I can already move on the delivery date.
changes it from a haggle to a joint problem

ejemplos.texto: I suspect what actually matters to you here is timing, not price — is that fair?
Before you even ask, I can move on the delivery date.
Let's treat this as a shared problem rather than two sides pulling in opposite directions.

notas: Naming the other side's real interest before they state it, and checking it (is that fair?), demonstrates genuine understanding rather than a tactical guess.
An unprompted concession, offered before it's requested, changes the frame from adversarial bargaining to joint problem-solving.
This only works if the named interest is actually accurate — a wrong guess here damages trust more than saying nothing.

contraste.es: Spanish has the same conditional tools for concessions (estaríamos dispuestos a… siempre que… – we'd be willing to… provided that…), so the language transfers. The C2 point is to attach every concession to a condition in the same sentence, so that it strengthens rather than weakens the position.
contraste.de: Wir wären bereit, …, vorausgesetzt, dass… corresponds exactly to we'd be willing to…, provided that…. German speakers therefore frame conditional concessions well in English.
contraste.it: Saremmo disposti a… a patto che… corresponds closely to we'd be willing to… provided that…. Note that a patto che takes the congiuntivo, while provided that takes an ordinary present.
contraste.fr: Nous serions prêts à… à condition que… corresponds closely to we'd be willing to… provided that…. Note that à condition que takes the subjonctif, while provided that takes an ordinary present.
contraste.pt: Estaríamos dispostos a… desde que… corresponds exactly to we'd be willing to… provided that…, with desde que in its conditional meaning. Conditional concessions therefore transfer directly.

errores: Naming an interest that's actually wrong, which reads as presumptuous rather than perceptive.
Making an unprompted concession so large it signals weakness rather than good faith.
Reframing to shared problem-solving rhetorically while still negotiating adversarially underneath.

redemittel.expresion: I suspect what actually matters to you is…

traducciones.es: Sospecho que lo que realmente te importa es…
traducciones.de: Ich vermute, was dir wirklich wichtig ist, ist…
traducciones.fr: Je soupçonne que ce qui compte vraiment pour toi, c’est…
traducciones.it: Sospetto che ciò che conta davvero per te sia…
traducciones.pt: Suspeito que o que realmente importa para ti é…

redemittel.expresion: Before you ask, I can already…

traducciones.es: Antes de que preguntes, ya puedo…
traducciones.de: Bevor du fragst, kann ich schon…
traducciones.fr: Avant que tu ne poses la question, je peux déjà…
traducciones.it: Prima che tu lo chieda, posso già…

redemittel.expresion: Let's treat this as a shared problem.

traducciones.es: Tratemos esto como un problema compartido.
traducciones.de: Betrachten wir das als gemeinsames Problem.
traducciones.fr: Considérons cela comme un problème commun.
traducciones.pt: Tratemos isto como um problema comum.

redemittel.expresion: Is that a fair read of where you're coming from?

traducciones.es: ¿Es una lectura justa de tu posición?
traducciones.de: Ist das eine faire Einschätzung deiner Position?
traducciones.fr: Est-ce une lecture juste de ta position ?
traducciones.it: È una lettura corretta della tua posizione?
traducciones.pt: É uma leitura justa da tua posição?

redemittel.expresion: That's not a concession I need you to earn.

traducciones.es: No es una concesión que necesites ganarte.
traducciones.de: Das ist kein Zugeständnis, das du dir verdienen musst.
traducciones.fr: Ce n’est pas une concession que tu dois mériter.
traducciones.it: Non è una concessione che devi guadagnarti.
traducciones.pt: Não é uma concessão que tenhas de merecer.

redemittel.expresion: What would actually solve this for both of us?

traducciones.de: Was würde das tatsächlich für uns beide lösen?
traducciones.fr: Qu’est-ce qui réglerait réellement cela pour nous deux ?
traducciones.it: Che cosa risolverebbe davvero questo per entrambi?
traducciones.pt: O que resolveria isto de facto para nós os dois?

autochequeo: Is the named interest checked, not just asserted?
Is any unprompted concession proportionate, not a signal of weakness?
Does the reframing to joint problem-solving hold up in substance, not just rhetoric?
Would the other party feel genuinely understood, not managed?
Is the tone collaborative throughout, not adversarial underneath a collaborative surface?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on whether the other party's interest is named accurately and checked, and whether any concession or reframing is genuine. Do not rewrite the text.

es: *Con la condición de que* rendered as *With the condition that* instead of *On condition that* or *Provided that*.
de: *Unter der Bedingung, dass* rendered as *Under the condition that* instead of *On condition that*.
it: *A condizione che* rendered as *At condition that* instead of *On condition that*.
fr: *À condition que* rendered as *At condition that* instead of *On condition that*.
pt: *Com a condição de* rendered as *With the condition of* instead of *On condition that*.
